items.html: (To the question) What is MAH of BAN? See above, Answer 15. (Item 152 and 153).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 79:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the Mochin of ZA? The Mochin drawn from the Aba and Ima of AB, who couple upon the MAN of the Mazalot, are discerned as the Mochin of the male, which is ZA, and the Nukva has no share in them, because those MAN are male MAN, from the aspect of the Yesod of Malchut, meaning the aspect of the Nukva in which the male is included. And therefore they belong only to ZA, who is male. But the Nukva receives the Mochin from ZA upon the Malchut of Ima in the head of ZA, which are Mochin of the female, meaning that they come out upon the aspect of the femininity of Malchut. As above in Answer 7, and Items 136 and 138.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 80:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the Mochin of the Nukva? See above, Answer 79 (there).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 81:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the Mazal of the name AB? The Mochin in the stature of AB that Aba and Ima receive do not come out except upon the MAN of the beard of AA, which are the aspect of the first restriction, as is known. And therefore the stature of AB of Aba and Ima is called by the name “the Mazal of the name AB”, meaning the stature of AB that comes out upon the MAN of the Mazal. (Item 178).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 82:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the diminishing of the moon? Here, the first time that the Partzuf of the Nukva was corrected, which was on the fourth day of the days of Genesis, when they ascended as MAN to the palace of Aba and Ima and received there the Mochin of the AB of the Mazal — ZA was included in Aba and the Nukva was included in Ima — they were then, in the secret of the verse “the two great luminaries”, of completely equal stature one to the other, for the Nukva received the Mochin of Ima, like ZA received the Mochin of Aba, and they became equal to one another, like Aba and Ima themselves. However, after they descended from there and came to their place, the Nukva was unable to stand in these Mochin that she had received from the NHY of Ima above, because the Hochma and Hesed within them were taken by ZA, and the Nukva received from them only the aspect of the Binot and Gevurot of Aba and Ima, which are the aspect of Hochma without Hassadim, like Ima of the AB of the Mazal herself. And Ima herself can stand in those Mochin, for the light of Ein Sof clothes in Ima only in Hochma alone, and she does not need a garment of Hassadim upon the light of Hochma. Not so the Nukva: the light of Hochma cannot clothe in her without a garment of Hassadim, because ZON are in their essence only the aspect of Hassadim, and of Hochma there is nothing in them, from their root in the worlds, but the aspect of illumination within their Hassadim. And therefore, at the time that she lacks Hassadim, also the light of Hochma cannot clothe in her. And therefore the moon complained: “two kings cannot use one crown”, for she could not stand in these great Mochin, equal to the AB of ZA, because of the lack of Hassadim, as above. And then it was said to her: “go and diminish yourself”, namely that she should return to the aspect of the point under the Yesod of ZA, so that she would receive the Mochin from the coupling made in the head of ZA upon the Malchut of Ima, for from this coupling Hochma is received by its clothing within the Hassadim, and then she can stand in these Mochin. As above in Answer 7. See there. And this matter is called “the diminishing of the moon”, because after she grew to a stature equal to ZA from his back, she returned and diminished down to the point under the Yesod of ZA. And know that this is the root of all the diminishings made in the Nukva after the completion of the building of her Partzuf from the back of ZA. For so it is always: after her receiving of the Aba and Ima of the back, she returns to the point under the Yesod of ZA and receives the Aba and Ima of the face-to-face. (Item 17).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 83:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the MAN of Bina in the Nukva? When the Nukva ascends as MAN with ZA to Aba and Ima to receive the Mochin of the Nesira, and receives there the Mochin of the AB of the Mazal, which are the aspect of the male MAN, it is discerned that the Nukva serves with the MAN of the NHY of Bina, by her inclusion in her NHY. But the Nukva herself has no aspect of MAN there, because those MAN are from the first restriction, and the aspect of the Malchut of the first restriction, which is the aspect of the MAN of the Nukva, is hidden in the unknown head (Reisha de-Lo Ityada), as above in Answer 7. But she serves there with a MAN that is not of her aspect, namely with the MAN of the Mazal, which is the MAN of the Ima of AB, as is known. (Item 138).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 84:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the MAN of the Nukva face to face? The MAN of the Nukva at the time that she is face to face are from the aspect of the Malchut of Ima, which is not included in the Mochin of ZA, drawn from the Mazal. As above in Answer 7. (Item 138).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 85:1
items.html: (To the question) What are Moses and Israel? See above, Item 64. (Item 177).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 86:1
items.html: (To the question) What is Netzach and Hod being one in the back? The quality of Netzach is that it is the aspect of the carrier for the illumination of Hochma, and the quality of Hod is that it is the aspect of the carrier for the screen upon which the coupling of striking is made. For from the aspect of the building of the Partzuf, Netzach is discerned as the aspect of ZA, similar to the crown of Hesed in the Mochin, which is the aspect of ZA and the carrier for the illumination of Hochma. And Hod is similar to the crown of Gevura, which is in the Mochin the aspect of the carrier for the screens. As above in Answer 6, see there. And therefore “the Netzach and Hod are one in the aspect of the back”, for when ZON are back to back, they are VAK without a head, and there is no aspect of the illumination of Hochma there at all. Therefore the quality of Netzach is not revealed at all, and it is included in Hod. But with the coming of the Hassadim, which are the Mochin of the GAR of ZON, then the Netzach and Hod are separated, for Netzach becomes the carrier for the illumination of Hochma, and Hod for the aspect of the reflected light. (Item 75).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 87:1
items.html: (To the question) What is Netzach and Hod being one in the head of the Nukva? At the time that the Nukva clothes the chest and below of ZA, back to back, the Netzach and Hod of ZA are found to be one, because there is no aspect of the illumination of Hochma revealed in Netzach, and Netzach is included in the quality of Hod, which is the aspect of the reflected light, as above in Answer 86, see there. And it is discerned that the Netzach and Hod of ZA are one in the head of the Nukva, who clothes the NHY of ZA from his back, meaning that there is no difference between them, and both are the aspect of the Nukva and the aspect of Hod. (Item 75).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 88:1
items.html: (To the question) What is Netzach and Hod becoming one in the Nukva? Even at the time of the greatness, when the Netzach and Hod were already separated one from the other in ZA, as above in Answer 86, nevertheless it is discerned that in the head of the Nukva, where the NHY of ZA clothe, the Netzach and Hod become attached one to the other within her. And this is for another reason. For it was explained above that the two crowns (Atrin), which are Tifferet and Yesod, have an equal relation to the Netzach and Hod. As above in Answer 86, and in Answer 6, see there. And it was explained above in Part 13 that in the aspect of the surrounding lights they are four Mochin — Hochma, Bina, Hesed, and Gevura — but in the aspect of the inner ones, when they clothe in the head of ZA, the two crowns of Hesed and Gevura are joined into a single aspect, into the brain of Daat, in the secret of the Shin of the three heads.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 89:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the Nukva, that she is always the back of ZA? Every lower one is discerned as the back of its upper, because it does not receive from the face of the upper but from its aspect of the back, as said in the previous parts. And therefore the Nukva, who is a lower to ZA, is always discerned as his back. (Item 76).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 90:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the Nukva at the height of her growth? The height of the growth of the Nukva is the seventh discernment, that she serves with him face to face in one crown. And this will not be until the future. As said above in Answer 6, see there. (Item 5 and 6).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 91:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the Nukva at the height of her diminishment? The height of the diminishment of the Nukva is the aspect of the point under the Yesod of ZA, from the aspect of the lights, and the point under the chest of ZA, from the aspect of the vessels. For this point is the Malchut of the vessels of the face of the Nekudim, and after they were corrected in Atzilut, no diminishment prevails in them any more. See above, Answer 11. (Item 5 and 6).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 92:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the gentle in the head and the strong in the end? This discernment of the gentle in the head and the strong in the end exists both in ZA and in the Nukva, but from particular aspects. And they are also discerned in the opposite discernment — of the strong in the head and the gentle in the end — and this too is both in ZA and in the Nukva. And it is because there are in ZA two kinds of Mochin: one is his own Mochin, which are from the male Gevurot, drawn from the first restriction. And he also has the Mochin for the sake of the Nukva, which clothe in his NHY, which become Mochin for the Nukva. And in his own Mochin, it is found that the Dinim of ZA are gentle in the head, for there is there a coupling upon his crown of Gevura, and it is sweetened. But in the end, namely in his NHY, they are strong, for there is no coupling there, because all the NHY are the ten Sefirot of conclusion, where is the strength of the Dinim that conclude toward the Partzuf. And from the aspect of the Mochin of the Nukva that are in him, in order to bestow to his Nukva, there is the opposite discernment, for they are strong in the head, because in the place of the exit of the Mochin of the Nukva in the head of ZA, the Malchut of Ima is found joined with the crown of Gevura of ZA, in order to bring out the stature of the Mochin of the Nukva. And therefore the aspects of the Dinim of the first restriction in the crown of Gevura also rule there, in the Mochin of the Nukva, and they are strong, as is known that the Malchut of the first restriction is the quality of judgment, in which the world cannot endure without the association of the quality of mercy, which is the second restriction. But in the end, namely in the NHY of ZA, which come in clothing in the Mochin of the Nukva, there is found there only the aspect of the Malchut of Ima, which is from the second restriction, and the aspect of the root of the Dinim, which is the crown of Gevura of ZA, remains in ZA himself, as is known. Thus there they are gentle in the end, namely in the NHY that became Mochin for the Nukva, which is the clothing of the sun in its sheath, for there is already nothing there but the aspect of the weak judgment alone, which is the aspect of the Malchut of the second restriction, which is the quality of mercy, as is known. Thus, from the aspect of his own Mochin, it is discerned as the gentle in the head and the strong in the end; and from the aspect of the Mochin of the Nukva found in him, it is discerned as the strong in the head and the gentle in the end.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 93:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the NRN of the male Hassadim? See above, Answer 60.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 94:1
items.html: (To the question) What are the kisses? The coupling of the two inner Partzufim of ZA and his Nukva, called voice and speech, is discerned as the coupling of kisses within them. (Item 178).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 95:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the closing of the eyes with the eyelids? At the time that ZA ascends to Aba and Ima in the secret of MAN, he remains then in his own place, in the aspect of VAK without a head, discerned as sleep, for he is like a sleeper, whose Mochin have departed from him. And with respect to the departure of his bestowal then from the Nukva, he is discerned as having closed his eyes with his eyelids, without looking at the Nukva, for every looking of the upper to the lower means the bestowal of the Mochin drawn from the eyes, which are the Hochma of the upper. And at the time of the departure of the Mochin of the upper, it is discerned that an aspect of a screen is made in the upper himself, discerned as the eyelids, for this screen prevents from him the bestowal to the lower. And because it is not an absolute screen, but only at the time of the raising of the MAN, therefore it is likened to the eyelids, namely in the aspect of closing and opening: at the time of his ascent as MAN he closes the illumination of the eyes, and at the time of his return below he opens them again. (Item 93).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 96:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the true AB? The stature of AB bestowed to the Nukva at the time that she is in a face-to-face coupling with ZA is discerned as the true AB, namely as the aspect of the Mochin of Chaya, which are the Mochin of birth. But the aspect of the AB of SAG, MAH, and BAN, which she receives at the time that she is in the back of ZA, in order to complete her vessels, is discerned as an AB that is only the aspect of the NRN of AB, and not actual AB. For before her vessels are completed in a complete stature, she cannot receive the aspect of complete Mochin. (Item 104).

items.html: (To the question) What are the backs of the BAN of BAN? Here, after the Nesira, ZA is discerned as being entirely MAH, namely MAH of MAH and MAH of BAN, meaning the Hochma and Hesed of Aba and the Hochma of the Hesed of Ima. And from the aspect of the names, they are the four aspects in the letters of the Havayah of MAH, which are Keter, Hochma, Bina, and ZA, as above in Answer 2. And the Nukva is entirely BAN, namely the Bina and Gevura of Aba, and the Bina and Gevura of Ima, called the BAN of MAH and the BAN of BAN. And they are only the number and the Gematria of the four aspects in the Havayah of MAH, as above in Answer 2.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 117:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the lower Partzuf being half of the upper? The root of this matter is in the Nekudim: at the time that the lower Hey ascended to the eyes, every degree was therefore divided into two. For the lower Hey ascended to the eyes, which is Hochma, and the degree ended there because of it, and the AHP went out and became a lower degree, as the Rav said above, page 432, item 44: that in the eyes was made the aspect of the last Hey, and YHV in the AHP. See there. Meaning that the AHP received a lower degree in YHV. As said there. And it is known that also the five Partzufim of Atzilut were all corrected in the aspect of the Malchut of the second restriction, as above in Part 13. Therefore it is discerned that every lower one is half a Partzuf of the upper one, namely the aspect of its AHP, for the AHP of the upper are always found in the GAR and eyes of the lower. And were it not for this knowledge in its clarity, there is no understanding in the Rav's discourses on ABYA, not even in a single word. And therefore he warns about this and says: “and this is a great rule, with which you will understand everything”. (Item 61).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 121:1
items.html: (To the question) What is his awakening from his sleep? When ZA rises as MAN to Aba and Ima, then all the aspects of his Mochin ascend there, both the inner Partzuf and the Mochin of VAK, and nothing remains below but the aspect of VAK of Ruach alone. And because of this he is discerned in the secret of slumber and sleep, like a sleeping man whose brains have departed. And after he received the Mochin there in Aba and Ima, he descends to his place, and the Mochin clothe in him; and the clothing of the Mochin in him is called his awakening from his sleep. (Item 127).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 122:1
items.html: (To the question) What is spirit within spirit? The coupling of the kisses is called a coupling of spirit within spirit, and this is in relation to the external Partzuf of the HGT. That is to say, they are discerned as spirit within spirit, even though they are truly GAR; but because the root of the GAR of ZA comes from the force of the HGT that became KHB, therefore the coupling of the GAR is discerned by the name Ruach, after its root. (Item 178).

items.html: (To the question) What are the 216 of back to back? The aspect of the spirit that her husband casts into her in the first union is not an aspect of true AB, but of AB of SAG, MAH, and BAN, which are three ABs that in Gematria are 216. And since it comes from the Mochin of AB of the Mazal, which the Nukva receives when she is in the back of ZA, therefore it is called the 216 of back to back. See above in Answers 60 and 70. (Item 103).

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 126:1
items.html: (To the question) What is the correction of Malchut not through ZA? The Mochin of the Nukva are the aspect of an offshoot of the Mochin of ZA, by a special coupling made in the head of ZA upon the Malchut of Ima, which is not included in the Mochin of the Mazal of ZA. And those Mochin clothe in the NHY of ZA, which became Mochin in the head of the Nukva. However, for the building of her Partzuf, she needs to receive from the Mochin of the Mazal, which are drawn from the upper Aba and Ima, and she receives them in the NHY of Ima themselves, and not in the NHY of ZA; and this is called the correction of Malchut not through ZA. See well above in Answers 6 and 7. (Item 174).
